{"text": "The `_post_start` method of the `WebSocketResponse` class initializes components needed for WebSocket communication after the initial HTTP handshake has completed.", "type": "intent"},
{"text": "The `_post_start` method takes a `request` parameter, which is an instance of `BaseRequest`.", "type": "structural"},
{"text": "The `_post_start` method takes a `protocol` parameter, which is a string indicating the WebSocket protocol version.", "type": "structural"},
{"text": "The `_post_start` method takes a `writer` parameter, which is an instance of `WebSocketWriter`.", "type": "structural"},
{"text": "The `_post_start` method sets up the WebSocket protocol.", "type": "behavioural"},
{"text": "The `_post_start` method initializes a `FlowControlDataQueue` as a data queue for reading messages.", "type": "structural"},
{"text": "The `_post_start` method configures the request's protocol to use a `WebSocketReader`.", "type": "behavioural"},
{"text": "The `_post_start` method disables HTTP keepalive so the connection is dedicated to WebSocket communication.", "type": "behavioural"},
{"text": "The `_post_start` method resets any heartbeat mechanisms.", "type": "behavioural"},
{"text": "The `_post_start` method asserts that the event loop (`_loop`) is not `None`.", "type": "behavioural"},
{"text": "The `_post_start` method does not return anything; it modifies the state of the `WebSocketResponse` instance by setting its `_ws_protocol`, `_writer`, and `_reader` attributes.", "type": "dataflow"},
{"text": "The `_post_start` method may start a heartbeat mechanism as a side effect.", "type": "behavioural"}
]
